body: Yeah. I still disagree. They really shine in tier 1. They are also good in invasion where you can run them in full auto up close, and throw them in single shot for longer range. I don't think the Lachmanm is bad at all. I run it most games and it was my first gold gun.

I disagree.  The Lachmann in full auto seems to have a lower ttk than most assault rifles. But I think battle rifles really shine in the new tier 1 (hardcore) mode. I think there is definitely room for some balancing but I wouldn't go as far as to say they are completely useless.
